heading: Accommodation
paragraphs: We've booked out the whole estate, so accommodation is right there on site — no taxi home, no missing the last dance. If you'd like to stay, let us know in your RSVP and we'll allocate your room and come back to you on costings.
If you'd prefer to stay locally, Todi and Perugia are both a short drive away with plenty of good options.
button_text: Let us know in your RSVP ↓
